finite_pass: six bounded connected life-sim chains, not all source

chains.name: Aging changes the useful body
chains.prerequisite: Human Status contains AGE; integrity/age-immunity aspects bypass penalties.
chains.decision: getAgeCategory uses thresholds30,40,50,62,74,90; use stage-specific aspects rather than raw age scalar.
chains.state: humanAging defines speed, recovery, dodge, health costs and tenacity gains; early middle age recovery -8 and tenacity +5; old age speed -0.8 and tenacity +20.
chains.time: AGE is consumed here, not advanced here. Interval transition is a separately inspected path if recovered.
chains.failure: No runtime proof that every category is applied in every mode. Ageless branch returns before numeric thresholds.
chains.later_consumer: Status aspect stats affect subsequent combat/recovery; downstream application bounded by recovered interval/factory methods, not assumed from counts.

chains.name: Survival leaves a scar and shortens service
chains.prerequisite: Alive injected hero eligibleForDeathChoice; no human_scar or filled head theme. Volunteer excludes maimed/escaped and respects forbidHeroicDeath.
chains.decision: Flee path chooses injury/withdrawal instead of final death.
chains.state: WITHDRAW_UNIT; NewPlot maimHero; AddHistory deathChoice_scar with permanent associatedAspects human_scar versus associatedAspectsThisCampaign human_scar_debuff. Debuff charisma -30, retirement age -10; scar changes skin.
chains.time: Actual PlotC_Maimed initialize marks maimedMustHeal, increments maimings and sets INJURY=HEALTH-1. travelHome selects safe visible town/station by path/threat score. waitToHeal inactivates control and waits for INJURY==0; interval/game-end/dungeon/immediate-recovery bypasses have explicit branches.
chains.failure: No controlled component kills plot entityNoLongerControlled; no start/path logs diagnostic and proceeds. Prior scar/head theme prevents scar choice. Invalid maimType falls back rightArm; no runtime proof of every branch.
chains.later_consumer: reactivate removes marker, stops campaign time, applies eligible heal-time theme or prosthetic history, swaps suitable replacement gear and restores active control. Scar debuff changes retirement eligibility while appearance/history retain cause.

chains.name: Retirement hands experience to a person
chains.prerequisite: Injected retiring hero and hook set of all retiring heroes; living ACTIVE volunteers excluded from retiring set and ranked by hero.LEVEL-LEVEL with threshold1.
chains.decision: Choose one of three rookies or resource alternative.
chains.state: Selected volunteer receives (hero.EXPERIENCE*3)/8 via GrantXP; alternative AddResources amount3. No XP subtraction from retiring hero in this data.
chains.time: Retirement event; exact interval scheduler inspected separately.
chains.failure: Optional candidate roles can be absent; no claim that unavailable choices are always rendered correctly. Dead/retiring heroes cannot receive the gift via these filters.
chains.later_consumer: New hero XP progression; distinct resource path keeps retirement meaningful without a qualified student.

chains.name: A generated childhood is future event eligibility
chains.prerequisite: History category with required/forbidden tags and optional legacy-unlock requirements. Existing history forbidden aspects plus virtual tags and current Status all participate.
chains.decision: HistoryIndex weighted valid selection; adds story-stat weight where supplied. Empty eligible list returns null.
chains.state: originChild_2 introduces intellectual/parent tags, hook_Curious and primeStats; HistoryGenerator converts line to dated Entry, associated aspects, relationships, prime-stat modifiers and persist policy.
chains.time: acquisitionTime = campaignTime.now or0 if absent; later curious intro needs unresolved Curious hook and morthagi threat.
chains.failure: Contradictory origins filtered; no valid line yields null. Curious intro forbids already-resolved hook and familyWith hook2.
chains.later_consumer: Curious intro assigns roles/advances plot; resolve adds a new dated history Entry. Not merely biography prose. Exact intermediary plot scheduling remains unread.

chains.name: Death changes the survivor rather than ending their story
chains.prerequisite: Alive eligible hero and LOVER_WITH.hero score>=1 lover in range6.
chains.state: Wait AddHistory on lover with promise aspect gives RETIREMENT_AGE+10; attack release memory gives WARDING+1. These inline histories persistOverLegacy never and bind hero relationship.
chains.time: Current campaign survivor aftermath, not automatic cross-campaign power retention.
chains.failure: Without a matched lover in range the event is unavailable; mortal choice can end the original hero.
chains.later_consumer: Survivor combat warding or longer active career; relationship-bound history can explain why.

chains.name: Legacy links obey conflicts and explicit retention
chains.prerequisite: Legacy data and loaded Status/History identities; lockedRelationship aspects must point to an available other hero.
chains.decision: Validator restores lover or rival only when neither side already has that type; forbidLegacyLockedRelationships suppresses it.
chains.state: LegacyAspectHelper first removes existing legacy-tagged aspects then adds retained legacy aspects for matching IDs, with history fallback; company unlocks are refreshed separately.
chains.time: Legacy refresh, not every random event; LegacySaveSystem only writes dirty legacy for participant on update/after when active.
chains.failure: Null legacy returns; missing relationships/IDs skip; existing lover/rival prevents overwrite. isActive=false prevents update work.
chains.later_consumer: Recruited hero has coherent links and retained aspects; dirty-only persistence avoids writing an unchanged legacy each update. Native/runtime serialization not exercised.

design_method: Connect aspect identity, dated history, event role matching and explicit legacy policy; structural original proposals only. Decompiled source is not runnable verification.
